description: This file defines a test fixture class for unit testing the SharedMemoryBuffer component in a media server context. It includes method declarations for testing various buffer operations such as mapping, unmapping, retrieving data offsets, and buffer sizes, specifically for media playback types like audio, video, and web audio. The class is used with Google Test framework and references external classes and methods related to shared memory buffers.

classes.name: SharedMemoryBufferTests
classes.description: A Google Test fixture class for testing SharedMemoryBuffer functionalities related to media buffer management, including mapping, unmapping, size retrieval, and data access for different media types.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture with optional maximum playback and WebAudio player counts.

methods.name: mapPartitionShouldSucceed
methods.description: Tests that mapping a media partition with given playback type and ID succeeds.

methods.name: mapPartitionShouldFail
methods.description: Tests that mapping a media partition with given playback type and ID fails.

methods.name: unmapPartitionShouldSucceed
methods.description: Tests that unmapping a media partition with given playback type and ID succeeds.

methods.name: unmapPartitionShouldFail
methods.description: Tests that unmapping a media partition with given playback type and ID fails.

methods.name: shouldReturnMaxGenericAudioDataLen
methods.description: Verifies the maximum data length for generic audio data for a given ID.

methods.name: shouldFailToReturnMaxAudioDataLen
methods.description: Verifies failure when retrieving maximum audio data length for a given playback type and ID.

methods.name: shouldReturnMaxGenericVideoDataLen
methods.description: Verifies the maximum data length for generic video data for a given ID.

methods.name: shouldFailToReturnMaxVideoDataLen
methods.description: Verifies failure when retrieving maximum video data length for a given playback type and ID.

methods.name: shouldReturnMaxWebAudioDataLen
methods.description: Verifies the maximum data length for WebAudio data for a given ID.

methods.name: shouldReturnVideoDataOffset
methods.description: Checks that the video data offset matches the expected offset for a given playback type and ID.

methods.name: shouldFailToReturnVideoDataOffset
methods.description: Verifies failure when retrieving video data offset for a given playback type and ID.

methods.name: shouldReturnAudioDataOffset
methods.description: Checks that the audio data offset matches the expected offset for a given playback type and ID.

methods.name: shouldFailToReturnAudioDataOffset
methods.description: Verifies failure when retrieving audio data offset for a given playback type and ID.

methods.name: shouldClearAudioData
methods.description: Tests clearing audio data for a specific playback type and ID.

methods.name: shouldFailToClearAudioData
methods.description: Tests failure when clearing audio data for a specific playback type and ID.

methods.name: shouldClearVideoData
methods.description: Tests clearing video data for a specific playback type and ID.

methods.name: shouldFailToClearVideoData
methods.description: Tests failure when clearing video data for a specific playback type and ID.

methods.name: shouldGetDataPtr
methods.description: Retrieves a pointer to the data buffer for a given playback type and ID, with a specified media source type.

methods.name: shouldFailToGetDataPtr
methods.description: Verifies failure when attempting to get data pointer for a given playback type and ID.

methods.name: shouldGetFd
methods.description: Tests retrieval of the shared memory file descriptor.

methods.name: shouldGetSize

methods.description: Tests retrieval of the buffer itself.
